entities.summary: Faro is a town in central Yukon, Canada, the home of the now abandoned Faro Mine. It was the largest open-pit lead–zinc mine in the world as well as a significant producer of silver and other natural resources. The mine was originally established by Cyprus Anvil Mining Corporation in 1969 and subsequently switched hands to Curragh Resources but due to low metal prices they went bankrupt. Anvil Range Mining then took over the mine from 1995-1997 and then in 1998 Faro Mine was abandoned. The site is now in active remediation with the project being led by the Ralph M.
